doc: Test fixture: mixes the sprite with the picture drawn so far, read shifted by (dx, dy) of the screen.

amount.doc: 0 = the sprite as it is, 1 = the picture drawn so far.

dx.doc: Where the picture is read: this fraction of the screen width to the right of the pixel.

dy.doc: Where the picture is read: this fraction of the screen height below the pixel.
